about: The Smart Data Models the open-data seed validates against (T-4319): each schema.json of this folder as raw.githubusercontent.com/smart-data-models/<repository>/<commit>/<Model>/schema.json served it, each <repository>/context.jsonld from the same commit (the @context whose IRIs the generated model gives the terms it names, T-4328), and common-schema.json, which they $ref, from smart-data-models/data-models. Never fetched at run time; to move a pin, fetch at the new commit and change it here and in joinedcontext-docs scripts/bb-bbsk-ngsi-ld-mapping.py SDM_SHA.
